content.comment_body: Good morning, I am having trouble setting and displaying negative temperature values on the [product_name] HMI panel, when reading data from a PT100 sensor using the [product_name] AM2RT2 module. Thank you.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note this is an English-speaking community. Kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you. Also, please avoid posting the same issue multiple times. Thanks.

This topic has been closed since the question was posted more than once. The second thread, titled 'Variables between HMI and [product_name]s,' is available in the '[product_name] - Communication' section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot configure or view negative temperature values on the HMI interface when using a PT100 sensor connected to an AM2RT2 module. This issue impacts their ability to accurately display temperature readings, highlighting a user experience challenge with handling negative values in the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the HMI panel to reliably show both negative and positive temperature readings. They seek a configuration that ensures negative values are displayed correctly and are not excluded or shown incorrectly.
